verdict.rationale: A state workforce agency could plausibly publish a public data API, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only web applications (UTR, UTS) and a desktop file-upload tool (QuickFile), with no documented endpoints, key-issuance path or rate limits. Probes for OpenAPI and Swagger specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As a developer, the service documents a public API for its data — published endpoints, a key-issuance path, and stated rate limits on its own pages
